release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.15 - Notification System Improvements:
- Fixed Android 13+ foreground service notification visibility
- Enhanced notification permission handling for all Android versions
- Improved iOS notification permissions and background handling
- Added iOS notification service with app lifecycle management
- Better socket reconnection on iOS when app resumes
- Improved notification initialization with retry logic
- Enhanced error handling and logging for notifications
- Fixed notification channel importance for Android 13+
- Better battery optimization handling
- Comprehensive notification troubleshooting guides added
